title: Equality-pinned components of canonical tensor pullback comparisons
statement: For a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] use the actual tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. The four component maps are the hom and inverse components of normalized pullback composition, transport along an equality of scheme morphisms, and the canonical pullback-power comparison [def-sc-tensor-pullback-power-comparison]. Each is the unique map equal to that existing canonical component. These names retain the same mathematical maps while preventing repeated expansion of their adjunction and sheafification constructions.
